event_summary: A suspended black kettlebell descends onto the left pillow while a suspended green sheet descends onto the right pillow and bends against it.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with two light gray pillows side by side on a wooden surface, with a black kettlebell hanging above the left pillow and a green rectangular sheet hanging above the right pillow. The kettlebell moves downward until it contacts the left pillow, after which the pillow surface visibly lowers and wrinkles around the contact area. The green sheet also moves downward, contacts the right pillow, and changes from hanging mostly vertical to lying partly bent and flattened on the pillow surface. By the end, both suspended items remain in contact with their respective pillows.

reasons: The two pillows, suspended kettlebell, suspended green sheet, hanging straps, wall, and wooden surface are visible before contact occurs.
